## Problem and use

Describe the problem and the people or workflows it affects.

## Proposed behavior

Explain the intended behavior and how it relates to the existing architecture.

## Evidence and alternatives

Share synthetic examples, relevant findings, alternatives considered and compatibility effects. Identify any effect on evidence preservation, permanent identities, current knowledge, history or operational work.

Keep confidential information and personal records out of the proposal. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the contribution process.
